entries.0391d63b79af0f13: This business brokers the buying and selling of real estate, acts as agent for sales, and purchases properties to resell them. It also manages and operates rental housing and student housing. Brokerage and similar services are provided by Tokyu Livable, Inc. Management, operation and sublease of rental housing and student housing are carried out by Tokyu Housing Lease Co., Ltd., Gakusei Joho Center Co., Ltd. and others. Tokyu Livable, Inc. also acts as entrusted sales agent for condominiums and detached houses sold by Tokyu Corporation, which is an other related company. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥356,804 million (¥343,704 million in the fiscal year ended March 2025), the second largest of the four reportable segments. The number of brokerage transactions for buying and selling increased to 33,922 (32,918 in the previous year). Together with the recording of more development projects in real estate sales, revenue increased. The number of managed rental housing units was 151 thousand at the end of the fiscal year ended March 2026.
entries.03fa64e8be229bb5: This segment covers management of condominiums and buildings. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue increased due to stable fixed income and an increase in renovation work.
entries.04c463a874f3447e: This business develops office buildings and commercial facilities for lease or sale, and also develops, sells and sells off condominiums for sale and rental housing. Tokyu Land Corporation and others carry out this business. Some office buildings are entrusted for management and operation to Tokyu Community Corp., and some commercial facilities are entrusted to Tokyu Land SC Management Corporation. Major facilities include Shibuya Sakura Stage and Shibuya Fukuras in Shibuya-ku, Tokyo. Condominiums for sale are developed and sold under the "BRANZ" brand, mainly in the Greater Tokyo and Kansai areas. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥397,351 million (¥346,118 million in the fiscal year ended March 2025), the largest of the four reportable segments. Leasing of offices improved, mainly in the Shibuya area, and the vacancy rate for office buildings and commercial facilities at the end of March 2026 was 0.7%. The number of condominium units recorded decreased to 899 units (1,006 units in the previous year). However, housing revenue increased due to a rise in sales to investors and others, and the business as a whole increased revenue.
entries.0f70e8bf0037ac37: Real Estate Investment Trust (REIT) Asset Management
entries.2f4cf31972884dcf: This segment covers housing sales (condominiums for sale) and sales to investors and others. Demand for condominiums remained firm, mainly in central Tokyo, and this segment increased revenue in the fiscal year ended March 2026.
entries.38e32a4968ef09ee: This segment covers leased offices, leased commercial facilities, and sales to investors and others. Leasing of offices improved, mainly in the Greater Shibuya area. However, due to a decrease in sales to investors and others, revenue for this segment declined in the fiscal year ended March 2026.
entries.4b7cd94306e236c1: A real estate group that develops offices and condominiums, centered on Shibuya, and is engaged in brokerage, building and condominium management, hotel operation and renewable energy businesses.
entries.4df55516b573f09a: This segment covers brokerage of buying and selling, real estate sales, and entrusted sales agency. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, the increase in the number of brokerage transactions and the recording of more development projects in real estate sales were the reasons for higher revenue.
entries.568886860286a633: Management of student housing and similar properties
entries.6338c0ef0758ec91: This segment covers real estate development in Indonesia, the United States and other countries. Revenue decreased in the fiscal year ended March 2026 due to a decline in the number of condominium units recognized for sale in Indonesia.
entries.77e9b92c19fce889: This segment covers hotels (Harvest Club, Tokyu Stay, resort hotels and similar), leisure (golf courses, ski resorts and similar), and healthcare (senior housing and similar). Hotels performed well by capturing inbound demand, but revenue for this segment declined in the fiscal year ended March 2026.
entries.87ccc028153f9f99: Management and operation of student housing
entries.940fca23eb0f233c: This segment covers environmental greening and landscaping, carried out by Sekisho Exterior Co., Ltd.
entries.9a199dbbe2c753a7: Management and operation of rental housing
entries.a5b9e84f02175889: Comprehensive management of condominiums and buildings
entries.a7301afdce320315: This segment covers renewable energy and Industry (logistics facilities, etc.). Revenue increased in the fiscal year ended March 2026 due to higher sales to investors in the Industry business.
entries.b1987bcd7dba21e1: This business develops, leases, operates and sells renewable energy power generation facilities and logistics facilities, and also manages real estate funds and REITs and invests in overseas real estate development. Power generation facilities and logistics facilities are handled by Tokyu Land Corporation and others, and management of some renewable energy facilities is handled by Renewable Japan Co., Ltd. (renamed Rie-ne Energy Co., Ltd. effective April 1, 2026). Private fund formation and management is handled by Tokyu Land Capital Management Corporation, REIT asset management by Tokyu Land REIT Management Corporation, and overseas development investment by PT.Tokyu Land Indonesia and Tokyu Land US Corporation, among others. The renewable energy business operates under the brand "ReENE". Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥141,303 million (¥108,952 million for the fiscal year ended March 2025), the smallest of the four reportable segments. Revenue rose in the Industry business (logistics facilities, etc.) due to an increase in sales to investors and other sales. Renewable energy facilities in operation totaled 223 at the end of the fiscal year ended March 2026, with a rated capacity of 2,077 MW (before conversion to equity share).
entries.bd03ffffb4de12a9: Investment in Overseas Real Estate Development
entries.c21055e866fd8b65: This segment covers REIT and fund management businesses, among others.
entries.d5fca36ca75c374b: This segment covers management of rental housing and student housing and similar properties. The number of managed units was 151 thousand for rental housing and 57 thousand for student housing and similar properties (both at the end of the fiscal year ended March 2026).
entries.f79f9620bf0693b3: This business carries out comprehensive management and renovation work for condominiums and buildings, operates hotels, golf courses, ski resorts and senior housing, sells membership resort hotels and similar products, and carries out environmental greening. Comprehensive management and renovation work for condominiums and buildings is carried out by Tokyu Community Corp. and others. Sales agency for membership resort hotels and similar products is carried out by Tokyu Resort Corp. Operation of hotels, golf courses and ski resorts is carried out by Tokyu Resorts & Stay Co., Ltd. Operation and management of senior housing is carried out by Tokyu E-Life Design Co., Ltd. Environmental greening and landscaping are carried out by Sekisho Exterior Co., Ltd. New businesses under the in-house venture system are also included in this segment. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥350,587 million (¥351,524 million in the fiscal year ended March 2025), the third largest of the four reportable segments. Management revenue increased due to stable fixed income and an increase in renovation work. However, wellness revenue decreased due to the transition of Ewell Co., Ltd. to an equity-method affiliate following the partial sale of its shares, and the business as a whole declined slightly. The number of managed properties at the end of the fiscal year ended March 2026 was 832,310 condominium units and 1,420 buildings and similar properties.
